cardEffects: [Main] Search your security stack. 1 of your Digimon may digivolve in to 1 yellow level 6 or lower Digimon with the [Vaccine] trait among them without paying its cost. Then, shuffle your security stack. If digivolved by this effect and you have Tamer with [T.K. Takaishi] in its name, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
name: Emissary of Hope

rulings.answer: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: When I use this card's effect to digivolve it into a yellow Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait in my security stack, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

When using this card's effect to digivolve a security card and I have a Tamer with [T.K. Takaishi], do I place 1 card in my security stack for <Recovery +1 (Deck)> before or after I shuffle my security stack?

rulings.answer: No, you can't. Since you have 3 cards in your security stack [BT8-024 Angemon]'s effect will trigger, but effects that add or remove cards from the security stack aren't allowed while looking at a security stack, so the effect won't activate.
rulings.question: I use this card's effect to digivolve my [BT8-024 Angemon] into a level 5 yellow Digimon card with the [Vaccine] trait in my security stack when my security stack has 4 cards. Can I activate my [BT8-024 Angemon]'s [Your Turn] effect to <Recovery +1 (Deck)> if it were to digivolve when my security stack has 3 cards?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 [Patamon] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to your hand.
